title: PRD handoff: legal data-residency matrix + engineering rollout constraints
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Overview: This ticket coordinates the PRD handoff for the Private Deployment workstream where legal data residency constraints intersect with engineering rollout constraints. The goal is to produce a single actionable artifact (Data-Residency × Implementation Matrix) that maps legal/regulatory requirements to concrete engineering options, required design changes, rollout risk mitigations, and test acceptance criteria.

Scope:
- Capture jurisdictional data residency requirements called out in the PRD and legal intake.
- Enumerate engineering implementation options (region pinning, encryption-at-rest key ownership, customer-managed KMS, VPC-only controls, on‑prem variant).
- Surface UX/design implications for customer onboarding, configuration, and error states.
- Produce a rollout constraints list: infra pre-reqs, migration steps, Backwards compatibility considerations, and dependency owner assignments.
- Obtain sign-offs from Legal, Security, Engineering (infra + runtime), and Design.

Out-of-scope: detailed implementation tickets for each engineering option (these will be spawned once matrix options are selected).
acceptance_criteria: Legal confirms matrix entries for all target jurisdictions (US, EU, UK, APAC) and signs off on recommended mitigation language
Engineering (Infra + Runtime) approves at least one implementable path per residency requirement with clear constraints and required effort estimate
Design approves customer-facing configuration flows and error/edge-state mocks for at least the top two implementation paths
Security signs off on KMS/HSM and key-management描述 (or provides a blocking comment) and adds any audit log requirements
A consolidated rollout constraints doc is published to Confluence with assigned owners, migration steps, and an initial test plan
